headline: Liverpool come from behind to beat shorthanded Brentford
description: Victor Muñoz and Alexander Isak take advantage of a weakened Brentford defence to score a pair of electric goals and lift Liverpool to a 2-1 comeback victory.

headline: Mikel Arteta: 'Big believer' Arsenal's Kai Havertz can score 30 goals a season
description: Mikel Arteta has said he is a "big believer" that Kai Havertz can be Arsenal's 30-goal-a-season man.

headline: Haaland, Man City hold off resilient Ipswich
description: Erling Haaland nets a double to extend his lead at the top of the goal-scoring tally as Manchester City take down Ipswich Town 3-2.

headline: Michael Carrick: Questions about Man United future 'not important' amid growing pressure
description: Michael Carrick has said his future as Manchester United head coach is "not important" ahead of a crucial clash against Leeds United.

headline: Aston Villa boss Unai Emery hails Johan Manzambi after winning goal: 'Here he can progress'
description: Unai Emery praised Johan Manzambi after his goal helped Aston Villa claim a 1-0 win over Newcastle at St James' Park.

headline: Nicol: Isak needs to contribute more for Liverpool despite winner vs. Brentford
description: Nicol: Isak needs to contribute more for Liverpool despite winner vs. Brentford
